purpose: decide review separation and safe trusted-server boundary without altering existing ERP
existing_main_facts: auth-gate.js frontend owner, admin, accounting can view/write billings; employee cannot
auth-gate.js frontend uses AAL2 and company context but does not provide trusted new-server signing verification
erp-store.js saveExternalBillingDocument uses expectedSnapshot, revision+1, history and original bill checks
billing-groups.js printSaved has separate current/history path and rejects current when source/settlements drift

candidate_policy.separation_of_duties: Reviewer must differ from last editor AND submitter; review-only roles are independent of existing billing write rights
candidate_policy.original_legacy: Do not retrospectively block confirmed unchanged saved legacy documents; preserve original print and historical lookup
candidate_policy.future_revision: New changed rearranged version must have a new independent approval; retained historic versions remain read only
candidate_policy.sole_editor_owner: No automatic override or self-approval; queue remains pending, operational fallback requires an approved policy and separately authorized reviewer
candidate_policy.evidence: Server-authoritative, immutable/tamper-evident log required; fake in-memory tests do not satisfy this
candidate_policy.release_effect: An approval only permits consideration of a future PDF-bytes validation gate, never delivery by itself

alternative_policy.separation_of_duties: Same strict independent reviewer condition; if sole owner is the editor, STOP until company explicitly chooses safe authorized escalation
alternative_policy.differences: Limits approval to owner; may require additional operational arrangements when only one owner or available reviewer

decisions_owner_must_make: Choose whether reviewer may be owner or admin, or owner only; establish safe exception/escalation for a one-person company without allowing silent self-approval
Approve treatment of pre-existing valid archived and already-issued/received customer billing, and cutover rule for newly saved versions
Decide whether dual review is needed for any special discount, value threshold, or already-invoiced originals; do not silently couple construction-only review with financial posting
Determine legal/audit retention for identities and approval events, and who may revoke approvals or deal with employee departure
formal_release_blockers: No verified single-document authoritative approved billing source from current JSONB ERP state
No trusted server JWT-signature/issuer/audience/expiration/session-revocation/AAL2 and company/document ACL/RLS integration
No durable externally tamper-resistant approval evidence and approved role/cutover policy
No real production PDF-first exact-byte gate or disposition of native browser print bypass
No full source-to-public privacy gate including handwritten notes, other zone and source invoice checks
No latest SYNCED or complete restorable backup verification, live financial regression, real logo/seal, desktop/mobile acceptance
No separate explicit owner authorization to change or release formal ERP
rules: All tests use FAKE actors and FAKE documents; never deploy or merge candidate authority in main/beta, never write Supabase or use a whole ERP snapshot as PDF input.
